note: Four-column table of exaltation constellations. Surya emitted the cells column-major and out of order. Read by eye; the exaltation degrees agree with the table on printed page 17, and each constellation's lord matches the standard Vimshottari lord of that nakshatra.
markdown:

| Moon | Krittika | Taurus 3rd | Sun |
| Mars | Dhanishtha | Capricorn 28th | Mars |
| Mercury | Hasta | Virgo 15th | Moon |
| Jupiter | Pushya | Cancer 5th | Saturn |
| Venus | Revati | Pisces 27th | Mercury |
| Saturn | Swati | Libra 20th | Rahu |
